title: Starving Rat Explains ALL Motivation 🚀 #shorts
description:
A study reveals starving rats pull harder towards cheese when a cat's scent is introduced from behind, demonstrating that fear can amplify desire. Alex Hormozi connects this dual motivation to success, explaining how superiority, insufficiency, and impulse control drive top performers. ⚡
